episodes.title: Survive the Night
episodes.summary: The survivalists arrive in Canada and spend their first night alone in the wilderness; as they attempt to build a shelter, their families watch from afar.

episodes.title: Gimme Shelter
episodes.summary: Tensions mount as families compete for the power to send in life-saving supplies to their loved ones; several families are on the verge of extraction as their survivalist must figure out how to get across the lake to get the next drop of supplies.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.summary: Emotions between family members in HQ erupt when faced with another challenge; the starving survivalists compete for food, while family members draw maps to get their family members to a food source in the forest.

episodes.title: Surviving the Storm
episodes.summary: The alliances at HQ are tested as families must anonymously provide critical supplies to one of the remaining survivalists; the survivalists face a decision that could affect both their fellow competitors in the wild and their families back at HQ.

episodes.title: Burn Before Reading
episodes.summary: The members in HQ must unanimously rank all the survivalists from strongest to weakest; family members get a chance to write a letter to their survivalist; an unexpected twist causes some family members to lose their momentum.

episodes.title: The Game Has Changed
episodes.summary: The survivalists attempt to hunt for food using the various weapons and tools their loved ones selected for them in the last supply drop; a family member at HQ must decide which of the remaining seven survivalists will receive critical supplies.

episodes.title: Family vs. Family
episodes.summary: With limited energy left in them, the survivalists are put head-to-head in a swimming race to retrieve a bag of supplies located in the center of the lake; the battle continues in HQ as families are pitted against each other.

episodes.title: Mystery Box
episodes.summary: A crucial supply box is stranded in the middle of a freezing lake, but only one survivalist can claim it in time; the families must guide their survivalists to crates filled with supplies using only a compass.

episodes.title: Banished
episodes.summary: A mystery crate creates tension amongst the families as they either keep or trade the items inside the box; a hidden advantage is placed in HQ which will be powerful for whoever finds it first and detrimental to another family.

episodes.title: The Final Drop
episodes.summary: The four remaining survivalists and their families at HQ go head-to-head; the survivalists must correctly guess a five-letter word chosen by their family at HQ to open the final supply drop; the survivalists must decipher a Morse code puzzle.

episodes.title: Alone in the Wild
episodes.summary: Eleven untrained contestants drop into the unforgiving Canadian wilderness.

episodes.title: A Game of Deception
episodes.summary: Ten families remain as survival in the wild becomes more brutal and the game in HQ becomes more cutthroat.

episodes.title: The Longest Night
episodes.summary: Tensions between families ignite when a survival trial takes place in total darkness and the survivalists only have the light their teams in HQ generate for them to complete the trial.

episodes.title: Sink or Swim
episodes.summary: As survivalists battle injuries, darkness, and a high-stakes raft trial in the wild, families at HQ form new alliances and target threats after a shocking extraction reshapes the game.

episodes.title: A Juicy Power Play
episodes.summary: As hunger takes its toll in the wild, a high-pressure food trial requires pivotal choices, while at HQ a hidden power card results in cutthroat decisions that leave two survivalists at a dangerous disadvantage.

episodes.title: Bitter Cold Consequences
episodes.summary: Survivalists compete in a wilderness scavenger hunt with game-changing consequences while a family at HQ makes a strategic choice that pushes one survivalist to the edge.

episodes.title: Breaking Points and Power Plays
episodes.summary: As relentless storms push survivalists to the edge, families at HQ fight for critical resources.

episodes.title: Swim for Your Life
episodes.summary: Survivalists battle through punishing trials for desperately needed supplies and a chance to communicate with their loved ones, while in HQ a secret plan is set into motion.

episodes.title: Banishment
episodes.summary: As survivalists battle exhaustion in the wild, a deception exposed at HQ ignites conflict while a ruthless island banishment results in one survivalist's extraction.

episodes.title: Last One Standing
episodes.summary: As the remaining three survivalists endure an island banishment, families at HQ battle to secure vital resources on final time for their loved ones, determining who will be the last one standing for $250,000.
